policy: Serenity Bridge v0 imports evidence-bearing market/disclosure datasets only. Valuation, rating, portfolio, buy-point and investment-decision outputs are intentionally excluded.

current_quote.description: Latest quote payload becomes a stock snapshot and source-backed raw artifact.

filings_announcements.description: Each announcement becomes a filing artifact routed to filing_pipeline.

financials.description: Latest structured financial period becomes a financial claim candidate with source-level limits.

provider_health.description: Provider health is summarized in dashboard/serenity_bridge.json.

data_gaps.description: Data gaps are retained on fetch_runs and the Serenity dashboard projection.
